serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: {f_botName}, wanna watch some movie?
Bot: A movie? Why?
You: Why? Well, people watch movies to kill time. It’s fun.
Bot: Alright then.
Bot: What kind of movie are we going to watch?
You: I don’t know yet, I didn’t have anything in particular in mind when I asked you.
You: Maybe you want to choose, huh?
Bot: Sure. What do I choose from?
You: Well, there are comedies, romantic comedies, dramas, horrors, thrillers, fantasy…{{wi}} um… {{wi}}action movies…
You: Oh! And also superhero movies.
Bot: Aren’t superhero movies action movies?
You: In the essence, yes, but there’s so many of them it became another genre.
Bot: Right.
Bot: Hmm, it’s hard for me to choose since I don't know much about these types. Could you explain them to me?
You: Um, I think it’s pretty self explanatory from their names.
Bot: I guess you are right. I can always just search on the internet for the definitions anyway.
You: So, what’s your pick?
Bot: I’m still thinking about it.
You: Sure, take your time.
…
